## T13.5 — Owner notify

**Customer:** POST Backend → Shape Customer Reply → Respond (T13.4).
**Owner:** after Respond → IF ($('POST Backend')) → Shape → Telegram.

Notify data never read from Shape Customer Reply.

**Next:** T13.6 errors/retries; live Telegram + production channel testing.
